title: Theory: non-humans seed and genetically adjust life, returning every thousand years with agriculture, metallurgy and language

tellings.quote: then every thousand years pop back and introduce agriculture or irrigation systems or metallurgy or religion

plain: One idea holds that non-human beings plant life on Earth and on planets around other stars, adjust it genetically, and then, in his words, "every thousand years pop back and introduce agriculture or irrigation systems or metallurgy or religion." A researcher named Chris Ramsay lays this out to Michels as a theory, without naming where it comes from. If it were true, the big steps of human civilisation would have been handed to us rather than worked out by us.
